sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game also features a wide range of power-ups, including the infamous 'Grimace Shake' ability, which can clear a set amount of lines in one go.

One of the standout features of Grimace Shake & Skibidi Tetris is its innovative use of sound effects and music. The Skibidi theme song is infectious and will have you hooked from the very beginning, while the sound effects provide a delightful accompaniment to the gameplay experience.
